tasks.name: 创建博客数据模型
tasks.description: 创建博客的数据模型，包括标题、内容、图片路径、创建时间等字段，保存到数据库。

tasks.name: 创建博客API接口
tasks.description: 创建博客的后端API接口，包含：获取博客列表、获取单篇博客、创建博客（含图片上传）、更新博客、删除博客。图片上传功能集成在创建/更新API中。

tasks.name: 创建首页
tasks.description: 创建首页HTML页面，显示欢迎信息、导航链接，以及创建新博客按钮。如果没有博客内容，显示提示信息。

tasks.name: 创建博客列表页
tasks.description: 创建博客列表HTML页面，展示所有博客的标题、摘要、图片，提供查看详情按钮。如果没有博客内容，显示提示信息和创建新博客按钮。

tasks.name: 创建博客详情页
tasks.description: 创建单篇博客详情HTML页面，显示完整内容、图片，并提供返回按钮。

tasks.name: 创建新建博客页面
tasks.description: 创建新建博客的HTML表单页面，包含标题、内容输入框和图片上传控件。表单支持实时验证，显示错误提示。

tasks.name: 创建404错误页面
tasks.description: 创建404错误页面，显示“页面不存在”提示，并提供返回首页按钮。

tasks.name: 实现图片上传功能
tasks.description: 实现图片上传功能，支持用户上传图片并保存到服务器。确保图片大小和格式验证。

tasks.name: 实现图片放大查看功能
tasks.description: 在博客详情页实现图片放大查看功能，用户点击图片可放大，点击外部区域恢复原大小。

T1.implementation_approach: Design a database schema with tables for blogs, including fields like title, content, author, created_at, and updated_at.
T1.notes: Ensure proper indexing for efficient querying.

T2.implementation_approach: Develop RESTful API endpoints for CRUD operations on blogs using a framework like Django REST Framework or Express.js.
T2.notes: Include authentication and validation for secure access.

T3.implementation_approach: Create a homepage with a clean layout displaying a welcome message and links to key sections like blog list and new blog creation.
T3.notes: Focus on responsive design for better user experience.

T4.implementation_approach: Develop a page that fetches and displays a paginated list of blogs using the API.
T4.notes: Include search and filter options for better usability.

T5.implementation_approach: Create a detailed view page that fetches and displays a single blog's content using its ID.
T5.notes: Add options for comments or related blogs if needed.

T6.implementation_approach: Design a form page for creating new blogs, with fields for title, content, and optional image upload.
T6.notes: Validate inputs and handle errors gracefully.

T7.implementation_approach: Develop a custom 404 error page with a user-friendly message and navigation links.
T7.notes: Ensure it integrates seamlessly with the routing system.

T8.implementation_approach: Implement an image upload feature using a library like Multer (Node.js) or Django's FileField, storing images in a cloud service or local storage.
T8.notes: Add size and format validation for uploads.

T9.implementation_approach: Use a JavaScript library like Lightbox or a custom modal to enable image zoom functionality on click.

Retrieve details of a single blog by its ID.

/.description: Homepage displaying welcome message and navigation links.

/blog.description: Page displaying a list of all blogs.

/blog/new.description: Page for creating a new blog post.

/blog/<id>.description: Page displaying the details of a single blog post.
